lead.en: SSC has not published the 2026 notification for the Constable (Executive) Male and Female in Delhi Police Examination, 2026 (checked 7 Nov 2026), and it is not in SSC's 2026 calendar. Everything below is from the 2025 notice and is shown as tentative reference, not as a 2026 rule.
lead.hi: SSC ने दिल्ली पुलिस में कांस्टेबल (कार्यकारी) पुरुष और महिला परीक्षा, 2026 की की 2026 की अधिसूचना जारी नहीं की है (7 नवंबर 2026 को जाँचा) और यह SSC के 2026 कैलेंडर में भी नहीं है। नीचे सब कुछ 2025 की सूचना से है और अस्थायी संदर्भ के रूप में दिखाया गया है, 2026 के नियम के रूप में नहीं।

title.en: Physical test (PE&MT), 2025 notice
title.hi: शारीरिक परीक्षा (PE&MT), 2025 की सूचना

facts.value: NO. As of 07.11.2026 no Notice of Examination for the 2026 cycle exists on ssc.gov.in. Three independent official checks confirm this (notice board, exam calendar, examination master data). See 'verification'.

NONE — the examination is absent from the calendar. The only Delhi Police entry in the 2026 calendar is 'Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police & Central Armed Police Forces Examination, 2026' (advertisement window 31.05.2026–30.06.2026, Paper-I (CBE) October–November 2026), which is a different examination.
18–25 years as on 01.07.2025; candidates should not have been born earlier than 02.07.2000 and later than 01.07.2007.

SC/ST 5 years; OBC 3 years; sportspersons of distinction 5 years (10 years for SC/ST); Delhi Police departmental candidates with at least 3 years' regular continuous service — up to 40 years (UR/EWS), 43 years (OBC), 45 years (SC/ST); sons/daughters of serving, retired or deceased Delhi Police personnel/ Multi-Tasking Staff — up to 29 years; Ex-servicemen — 3 years (UR/EWS), 6 years (OBC), 8 years (SC/ST) after deduction of military service rendered; widows/divorced/judicially separated women who have not re-married — 5 years.

10+2 (Senior Secondary) passed from a recognised Board; relaxable to 11th pass for (a) sons/daughters of serving, retired or deceased Delhi Police personnel/ Multi-Tasking Staff of Delhi Police and (b) Bandsmen, buglers, mounted constables, drivers, dispatch riders, etc. of Delhi Police only.
Male candidates must possess a valid driving licence for LMV (motorcycle or car) as on the date of the PE&MT; a learner licence is not acceptable.
The post is not identified as suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD).

INR 100 (Rupees One Hundred only). Women candidates and candidates belonging to SC, ST and Ex-servicemen eligible for reservation are exempted. Payment online only through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Visa/Mastercard/Maestro/RuPay debit cards. Fee is non-refundable and non-adjustable.

Computer Based Examination (CBE), then Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PE&MT) with Document Verification, then Medical Examination. PE&MT is essential but qualifying in nature; PE&MT/ DV are conducted by the Delhi Police in Delhi only.
Unreserved 35; SC/ST/OBC/EWS 30; ESM 25 (normalised, without adding NCC bonus marks).

label.hi: PE&MT के लिए शॉर्टलिस्टिंग (2025 की सूचना)

facts.value: Candidates are shortlisted category-wise on the basis of merit in the CBE; the number shortlisted is around 12 times the number of vacancies.

NCC 'C' certificate: 5% of the maximum marks of the examination; 'B' certificate: 3%; 'A' certificate: 2%. Granted only on production of the original certificate at PE&MT/ DV; not available to Ex-servicemen; crucial date is the closing date for receipt of the Online Application Form.

facts.value: Distinction 5%, First Class 4%, Second Class 3%, Pass Class 2% of the maximum marks of the examination, on production of the original certificate at PE&MT/ DV; crucial date is the closing date for receipt of the Online Application Form.

label.hi: अंक बराबर होने पर (2025 की सूचना)

facts.value: Marks in Part-A, then marks in Part-B, then date of birth (older candidate placed higher), then alphabetical order of names.

Height minimum 170 cm — relaxable by 5 cm for residents of hill areas (Garhwalis, Kumaonis, Gorkhas, Dogras, Marathas and candidates belonging to Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya, Assam, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir and Leh & Ladakh), 5 cm for ST candidates and 5 cm for sons of serving/ retired/ deceased Delhi Police personnel/ Multi-Tasking Staff. Chest 81 cm with a minimum 4 cm expansion (81–85 cm), with the same relaxations.

Height minimum 157 cm — relaxable by 2 cm for residents of hill areas (same list as above), 2 cm for SC/ ST candidates and 5 cm for daughters of serving/ retired/ deceased Delhi Police personnel/ Multi-Tasking Staff of Delhi Police.

Sound state of health, free from defect/ deformity/ disease; vision 6/12 without glasses in both eyes, free from colour blindness and without any correction such as glasses or surgery of any kind to improve visual acuity; no relaxation is permissible to any category on this count. Tattoos permitted only if they depict religious symbols or figures and names as followed in the Indian Army, are on traditional sites (inner aspect of the left forearm or dorsum of the hands), and are less than one-quarter of the size of that part of the body.
